json.name: DFT Electronic Structure Simulation Workflow
json.description: A robust computational workflow for performing Density Functional Theory (DFT) simulations to predict and analyze the electronic band structure and density of states of semiconductor materials. The workflow automates input file generation, execution of DFT codes, and post-processing of results, including visualization.

input.name: Crystal Structure File
input.encodingFormat: Chemical Markup Language (CML) or Crystallographic Information File (CIF)
input.description: Input file describing the atomic positions and lattice parameters of the material.

input.name: DFT Parameter File
input.description: Configuration file specifying DFT calculation parameters (e.g., k-point mesh, exchange-correlation functional).

output.name: Electronic Band Structure Data
output.description: Data points for the calculated electronic band structure along high-symmetry k-paths.

output.name: Density of States Data
output.description: Data for the total and projected density of states.

output.name: Band Structure Plot
output.description: Visual representation of the electronic band structure.

output.name: Density of States Plot
output.description: Visual representation of the density of states.

json.citation: J. Doe et al., 'Automated DFT Workflows for Semiconductor Material Discovery', Journal of Computational Materials, 2024, DOI: 10.xxxx/j.jcomat.2024.xxxxxx
